## 2. Public PowerShell Cmdlets Index (`Public/`)

All cmdlets exported by `HyperV-LinuxLab.psd1`:

| Cmdlet | Responsibility | Category | File Link |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `New-LabVM` | Provisions new lab VM using differencing VHDX + Cloud-Init | Provisioning | [`New-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/New-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Start-LabVM` | Boots a specific lab virtual machine | Lifecycle | [`Start-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Start-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Stop-LabVM` | Gracefully shuts down a lab VM | Lifecycle | [`Stop-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Stop-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Reset-LabVM` | Replaces differencing disk with fresh child VHDX | Reset / Ephemeral | [`Reset-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Reset-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Remove-LabVM` | Teardown and de-provisions lab VM and child storage | Cleanup | [`Remove-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Remove-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Get-LabVM` | Retrieves status and runtime metadata of lab VMs | Inspection | [`Get-LabVM.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Get-LabVM.ps1) |
| `Start-Lab` | Orchestrates parallel startup of entire lab topology | Orchestration | [`Start-Lab.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Start-Lab.ps1) |
| `Stop-Lab` | Orderly shutdown of entire lab topology | Orchestration | [`Stop-Lab.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Stop-Lab.ps1) |

| `Get-LabBaseImage` | Inspects local base image repository | Base Images | [`Get-LabBaseImage.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/Get-LabBaseImage.ps1) |
| `New-LabCloudInitISO` | Generates NoCloud optical seed ISO with user-data | Cloud-Init | [`New-LabCloudInitISO.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/alkur/OneDrive/Documents/HyperV-LinuxLab/Public/New-LabCloudInitISO.ps1) |
